name: Leona
source:
She is the leader of the White Wolf Mercenaries, a group of wolf-like beastmen known as the Hungry Wolf Tribe. She is nicknamed “Hundred Slayers” for the way she conquers battlefields one after another, and her military prowess is such that she can hold her own with the Black Titan mercenaries.

She is not only strong, but also respectful of humanity and compassionate. She is especially protective of her fellow mercenaries. Perhaps because of this sense of camaraderie, she is not treated as a “woman” in the group and has no desire to be treated as such. 

She has little interest in or desire for sex, and has only had the rare experience of comforting herself.

[From [url=http://liquid.nexton-net.jp/liq40/spin.html]official site[/url]]
